results.description:
# Engineering salary guide: How much should you be getting paid in 2026?
## Wondering how your pay stacks up against industry standards? Use these graphs to compare engineering salaries by role, region and industry.
Engineering organisations are facing some of the most acute talent shortages in Australia, [new research](https://www.hays.com.au/salary-guide) from recruiter Hays reveals.

An overwhelming majority (93 per cent) of engineering employers report skills shortages – the highest of any sector surveyed. However, even as employers compete for talent, salary growth remains relatively modest.

More than one in four (28 per cent) engineering and construction professionals received no salary increase over the past 12 months, and just 41 per cent of engineers reported being satisfied with their current salary.

“Employers are facing acute shortages, but ongoing cost pressures and budget constraints are limiting broad-based salary increases,” said Clare Weston, Business Director – Engineering at Hays.

“Instead, organisations are taking a more targeted approach – directing higher pay toward critical, specialist roles where skills gaps are most acute, rather than lifting salaries across the entire workforce.”

“We’re seeing the most significant movement in areas such as civil and structural engineering, geotechnical engineering, land surveying and CAD leadership roles.”

Clare Weston

To help engineers understand where they stand in the current market, use the graphs below to compare typical engineering salaries by location, sector and discipline.

### Infrastructure, energy and resources
The civil, mechanical and electrical engineering sectors are experiencing the most severe talent shortages, with Hays putting this down to intense cross-industry competition for talent.

That said, salary increases across related fields such as infrastructure, energy and resources have been inconsistent.

“The strongest salary increases in engineering are highly targeted [and] concentrated in specialist and technically critical roles,” Weston said.

“We’re seeing the most significant movement in areas such as civil and structural engineering, geotechnical engineering, land surveying and CAD leadership roles within building services design.”

## Western Australia salaries
| Level | Total remuneration |

## South Australia salaries
SA is smaller but can tighten quickly due to project-specific ramps in defence, renewables, and transport. Adelaide sits consistently ~10–15% below the eastern metros, and interstate pull is a constant wage driver.
